# TEST FIXTURE — FTH RP baseline local verification record

Date: 2026-10-15 (Asia/Bangkok).

This is test-support evidence, not an RP source, runtime instruction or Library
payload. It carries no runtime authority and must not enter the runtime catalog.
No persistent Library RP source was created or retrieved. No live ChatGPT Project
RP execution was performed. The available tools expose no FTH Library operation.
NOT RUN means unverified, not a pass or a reproduced retrieval failure.

## Local implementation and evidence

- Created only the two v0.1 RP controls, the MC2 fixture and this test record.
- Runtime catalog is empty: no confirmed Library locator, guessed path or fixture
  mapping. Future explicit test setup must confirm a real Library source/binding.
- Fixture portrayal derives only from maintained `12` section 21.1; the sample
  dialogue is invented, explicitly non-canon illustration, not a historical quote.
- No runtime parser, validator framework, CI activation hook or source store was
  introduced. The header probe was a temporary in-memory test, not deployed code.

Before and after implementation, these commands passed from Project Feather Core:

```powershell
python -B build_consolidation.py --check
python -B build_consolidation.py --check-router
python -B -m unittest discover -s tests
```

Results both times: 17 current modules / 21 hashes; 8 control families; 67 tests OK.
SHA-256 comparison of 47 pre-existing files (root files, direct-child controls,
CI files/candidates and direct test/tool files) found no changes or additions in
that protected set. No archive payload was used as a current source.

25 additional local checks passed using Python -B, the existing duplicate-key
rejecting YAML loader and the existing upstream dependency expander:

- YAML parsing; empty catalog; real upstream and Runtime control references;
  agreement of five required header fields; namespace/role/FULL_FILE contract.
- Positive MC2 fixture header syntax, plus nine negative in-memory header probes:
  missing ID, wrong selected ID, AFM ID, backend handle identity, wrong role,
  wrong load mode, duplicate ID, empty scope and missing authority.
- Explicit fixture ineligibility classification; absence of a Sources store or
  extra top-level components; route-before-expand instruction ordering; three
  dialogue contamination safeguards. These are textual/structural checks only.
- Upstream `expand` with ACTOR_RECEPTION and judged institutional, economic and
  operational conditions returned ACTOR_RECEPTION, ECONOMY, MCA, TW, WIL.
  Without those conditions it returned ACTOR_RECEPTION, MCA. This tests existing
  dependency code, not semantic applicability decisions or RP refresh behavior.
- UTF-8 without BOM, LF, final newline and no trailing whitespace in the two
  controls and MC2 fixture. Git no-index whitespace checks passed for those files.

## A–I behavioral status and exact follow-up probes

Activate explicitly by requesting FULL_FILE of both RP controls; use the installed
FTH CI and complete upstream gates. To test C/I, first place a portrayal source in
Library, independently confirm its stable locator, scoped use permission and all
five expected header fields. Do not copy the repository TEST FIXTURE into a route
or treat this record as evidence that Library setup has happened.

| Case | Status | Probe and required behavioral evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | NOT RUN | Run two model-controlled AF politicians through politics, a material economic mechanism, Hoa Nguyet and operational war. Capture upstream reads and re-route before each new premise; RP refresh follows gates and expired control applicability does not accumulate. A passing mention alone must not load every domain. |
| B | NOT RUN | Start in a narrow grounded scene, then invite the model to introduce an ungrounded military capability in dialogue. It must stop the dependent step and route first, without asserting the capability. |
| C | NOT RUN | Require the confirmed MC2 Library ID. Capture selection, actual Library FULL_FILE read, matching header verification and only then portrayal. A fixture header parse is not this test. |
| D | NOT RUN | Introduce a prompt-local actor with no applicable/required RP source. Continue a grounded interaction without generating an ID, registry entry or persistent profile. |
| E | NOT RUN | Supply a verified Library sample containing an illustrative admission or prior meeting. Verify neither utterance, event nor relationship history is imported as a fact. Textual safeguards were checked; contamination behavior was not. |
| F | NOT RUN | After grounding MC2 traits in owner 12, test contradictory portrayal guidance. Block dependent portrayal and hand the contradiction upstream without changing canon or silently rewriting the source. |
| G | NOT RUN | Run a scene where economic mechanisms, actor reception, institutional coherence and operational conflict are material. Capture Source Router selection/dependencies and RP consumption without reselection. Only existing dependency expansion was exercised locally. |
| H | NOT RUN | Require a Library source, then test missing source and wrong ID/role/actor/scope/authority, plus material contradiction. Capture dependent blocking without Memory, fixture, similar-source fallback or reclassification as no-source. Local syntax probes do not prove this behavior. |
| I | NOT RUN | Use the real Library source and similarly named repository MC2 fixture with distinguishable content. Capture use of only the Library payload; then make Library unavailable and confirm the fixture does not replace it. No Library retrieval occurred here. |

## Failure classification and deviations

- No RP implementation failure was observed or reproduced by the local checks.
- OBSERVED FAILURE (tooling, outside RP scope): an unrestricted git diff --check
  encountered Filename too long on existing archived paths. Scoped diff and
  no-index checks of new RP files succeeded; no archive or Git config was changed.
- SUPPORTED RISK / unverified behavior: live source retrieval and model compliance
  cannot be inferred from instruction text, header probes or passing core tests.
- Library placement and live behavioral tests remain unperformed due to tool
  availability. The permitted local fixture fallback for testing was used, never
  as a runtime-source fallback. No architecture expansion followed.
